summary: Proposes a Telnet option that lets a client control a serial port on a remote device, for example to set the line speed. The goal is to make modems attached to a network usable for outbound dialing. It is an experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: It lets your computer reach across the network and use a modem plugged into a different computer, as if it were plugged into your own.
